message.content: {"caption":"A bordered prompt panel describing rules for inspecting a chronological SQLite transcript and keeping memory edits auditable.","description":"One wide rectangular text panel with a thin blue border and a pale blue-gray background. A bold teal heading at the upper left reads “Prompt 2: SQLite transcript-mode addendum.” Beneath it, a black paragraph says the transcript is stored as one chronological SQLite turns table; `conversation_manifest` and the read-only `conversation_sql_query` should guide how it is inspected. It says the harness does not divide the transcript into pages or secretly scan it to create missing-fact lists, memory changes should cite inspected turn ranges, and coverage must not be claimed for rows that were not actually inspected. There are no arrows, icons, or other visual components.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
